'''Massoss''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Massoss system]], a part of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]] area of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Phalanx Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the planet [[Cormit/Legends|Cormit]]. Massoss was an outlying [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and was home to one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] that ruled over the Chiss Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss.<ref name="TEA" />

At some point by [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], the Ruling Family of Massoss employed hives of the sentient [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] as a work force. As a result, the Family [[Chiss civil conflict|fell]] out of power that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and its members became [[Joiner]]s&mdash;a part of the Killiks' [[Hive mind/Legends|hive-mind]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Massoss was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square G-8.<ref name="TEA" />
